San Jose

Technology

Responsibilities

Team Introduction: The EE Platform team focuses on silicon and EE architecture for AR/VR platforms to optimize the system power, latency and performance. The team innovates on customized silicon solutions for imaging, display and connectivity with HW/SW co-optimization.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship in 2027. PhD Internships at our Company aim to provide students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, and to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies.

PhD internships at Our Company provides students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, and to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies. Our dynamic internship experience blends hands-on learning, enriching community-building and development events, and collaboration with industry experts.
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early. Please state your availability clearly in your resume (Start date, End date).

Topic Content: The rapid advancement of AI Agents is set to have a far-reaching and transformative impact on daily life. As the hardware bridge linking AI Agents to the physical world and end users, intelligent hardware acts as a vital gateway for agents to perceive their environment and recognize user intent. Enabling AI Agents to maintain round‑the‑clock environmental awareness and efficiently capture real‑time user intentions is essential to improving their everyday service experience. This topic seeks to overcome the limitations of conventional visual perception systems. By deeply integrating sensing and computing, it explores full‑stack innovation spanning from low‑level hardware to high‑level algorithms. Key efforts include developing next‑generation sensors with real‑time understanding capabilities, investigating non‑traditional visual capture and compression techniques, and designing novel hardware architectures to run advanced algorithms—enabling highly efficient coordination across sensing, processing, and communication.

Topic Challenge: Break free from the framework of conventional sensing systems, explore novel sensors, signal processing and compression schemes to achieve highly energy-efficient sensing tasks, while enabling seamless integration with large models.

Topic Value: Breakthroughs in this research direction will enable intelligent hardware to better connect AI, users, and daily life. Against the backdrop of the AI Agent era, this will unlock the gateway to the next generation of intelligent hardware terminals and open up broader technological possibilities.

Responsibilities:
- Innovate and develop a power-efficient, low-latency, highly-intelligent all-day machine perception vision system.
- Develop necessary training, data collection/generation pipeline along with state of art ML algorithm/framework for understanding of the scene and user behaviors.
- Map the cutting edge ML algorithm to the HW accelerator, identify performance bottleneck, optimize performance and efficiency, propose more efficient HW/SW co-design for AI accelerator.
- Collaborate with the x-functions team and translate system requirements into a proper cloud-edge workload partition and edge ML accelerator HW/SW requirement.
- Perform quantitative evaluations through the use of system modeling and influence sensor, soc and software co-design.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Currently Pursuing PhD in the fields of Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics and related technical discipline.
- Experience in research in the fields of computer vision, edge ML perception algorithm and/or related AI accelerator design.
- Experience with programming tools and languages such as C/C++, MATLAB, Python.

Preferred Qualifications
- Familiar with appropriate ML frameworks and model deployment.
- Familiar with image sensor and isp
- Good track record on top-tier conference or journal publication

Job Title

Enterprise Analytics Intern

Job Purpose

The Enterprise Analytics Intern will support business teams by transforming data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making across Hormel Foods. This role provides hands-on experience in analytics, category management, revenue growth management, and sales performance reporting while partnering with cross-functional teams to identify business opportunities and trends. The intern will develop analytical, storytelling, and problem-solving skills through meaningful projects that support enterprise growth initiatives.

Responsibilities

- Analyze category, consumer, customer, and sales performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and business risks
- Create and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reports using enterprise analytics tools
- Support enterprise analytical initiatives through market, consumer, and competitive analysis
- Assist in developing recommendations that improve business performance, market share, and customer outcomes
- Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer key business questions from stakeholders
- Translate complex data findings into clear and compelling presentations for business partners
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Revenue Growth Management, and Insights
- Monitor category and industry trends to provide actionable business recommendations
- Present project findings and recommendations to department leadership at the conclusion of the internship

Required Qualifications

- Must graduate between August 2027, December 2027, May 2028 with a Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Professional Selling, Marketing, Business Administration or a related field with a minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA preferred
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, and data analysis tools
- Possess knowledge of syndicated data, spreadsheets, databases, and category management tools. Experience with PowerBI and Tableau or similar analytical tools would be beneficial.
- Experience working with large datasets and presenting findings
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Interest in consumer-packaged goods, retail analytics, category management, or business intelligence preferred
- Applicants must not now, or at any time in the future, require employer sponsorship for a work visa
- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer

Hormel Foods does not offer sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based visas.

About Our Internship Program

The Hormel Foods internship program is designed with your growth in mind. As an intern, you'll gain hands-on experience working on meaningful projects that support real business initiatives while developing the skills and confidence needed to launch your career.

In addition to day-to-day responsibilities, you'll have opportunities to connect with fellow interns, build your professional network, participate in development and learning sessions, and interact with leaders across the organization. You'll leave the summer with valuable experience, lasting connections, and a deeper understanding of what it's like to work for a Fortune 500 company.

We're proud to be recognized among the nation's Top 150 Internship Programs by Vault.

Duration

Our summer internship program runs 10-12 weeks and starts in late May and ends in early August.

Hours

This is a temporary, full-time, hourly position. Interns can expect to work approximately 40 hours per week and may be eligible for overtime based on business needs.

Location(s)

- This is an on-site position based out of our office in Eden Prairie, MN.
- Hormel Foods does not currently offer remote internship opportunities.

Compensation/Benefits

- Competitive hourly pay paid on a weekly basis
- Housing assistance through either a housing stipend or company-provided housing, depending on location
- Reimbursement of eligible relocation expenses
- Reimbursement for approved business-related expenses
- Opportunity to participate in a 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
- Paid time off (PTO) accrual
- Hands-on experience with a Fortune 500 company
- Professional development opportunities and networking experiences
- Potential consideration for future internships, co-ops, or full-time employment opportunities

About The Program:
The Doors Internship Program is an immersive experience designed to build your expertise, grow your network, and give you hands-on experience across different functions. You’ll work on real-world tasks and/or projects, receive mentorship from experienced professionals, and be part of a company that enhances people’s lives through innovation in comfort-driven design and manufacturing.

At Leggett & Platt, we design and manufacture advanced seating components, comfort systems, and engineered solutions for the world’s leading automotive brands. Our teams blend innovation, precision engineering, and global collaboration to deliver products that enhance the driving experience.

In This Role:

As a Systems Engineer Intern, you’ll work alongside experienced engineers to support the development, integration, and validation of complex automotive systems that power next‑generation vehicle comfort and motion technologies. You will gain hands‑on experience across the full systems lifecycle — from requirements and design to testing and validation. You will support engineering teams working on embedded systems, electromechanical components, and automotive comfort technologies.

So, what will you be doing as a Systems Engineer Intern?

- Systems Requirements & Documentation: Assist in gathering, analyzing, and documenting system requirements for automotive components and subsystems.

- System Architecture & Design Support: Contribute to system block diagrams, interface definitions, and design reviews.

- Testing & Validation: Support test planning, execution, and data analysis for system‑level and component‑level validation.

- Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Work with engineers to identify issues, analyze failures, and support corrective actions.

- Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Partner with mechanical, electrical, software, and quality teams to ensure system alignment and performance.

- Modeling & Simulation (as applicable): Assist with system modeling, simulation, or analysis tools used in the design process.

- Continuous Improvement: Participate in process improvement initiatives, documentation updates, and workflow optimization.

To be successful in this role, you’ll need:

- Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.

- Interest in automotive systems, embedded technologies, or electromechanical design.

- Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively in a team environment.

- Curiosity, initiative, and a desire to learn in a fast‑paced engineering setting.

- Detail-oriented mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Things we consider a plus:

- Exposure to systems engineering principles (requirements, V‑model, validation).

- Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink, Python, or similar tools.

- Experience with CAN, LIN, or other automotive communication protocols.

- Understanding of basic electrical or mechanical systems.

- Coursework or project experience in embedded systems, controls, or mechatronics.

What to Do Next

Now that you’ve had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available.

Our Values

Our values speak to our shared beliefs, and describe how we approach working together.

- Put People First reflects our commitment to safety and care of each other, learning and development, and creating an environment of mutual respect, empathy and belonging.

- Do the Right Thing focuses us on acting with honesty and integrity, delivering the results the right way, taking pride in our work, and speaking the truth – good or bad.

Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems.

Our trading teams are each comprised of a dynamic group of traders, quantitative researchers, and engineers who work together to examine the global markets, seeking to understand the complexities of various traded products and exchanges. They leverage their impeccable statistical analysis and data mining skills, using the results of their research to make forecasts and develop profitable predictive trading models.

We are seeking research scientists with a demonstrated ability to apply machine learning to achieve state-of-the-art capabilities in complex and challenging domains. The ideal person for this role will be capable of implementing an open-ended research project from concept to production and continuously improving model design, tools, and infrastructure. Potential projects may target any area of the quantitative research and monetization process. We believe that successful research efforts require a fluid mix of skills including AI/ML expertise, engineering pragmatism, statistics, and market intuition.

What You'll Do:

- Apply state-of-the-art techniques to complex and challenging domains.

- Work closely with researchers and quants to build flexible and reusable frameworks for financial ML.
